# SpelmanTax – Dott.ssa Galja Spelman

> Italian chartered accountant (Dottore Commercialista) in Bolzano, Italy, registered with the Ordine dei Dottori Commercialisti e degli Esperti Contabili di Bolzano (no. 914/A). SpelmanTax handles the full Italian tax and accounting side for private clients, freelancers and companies – in Italy and abroad – in Italian, German, English and Russian. Work is done mainly online (email, WhatsApp); meetings at the Bolzano office by appointment.

Key facts:
- Name: SpelmanTax – Dott.ssa Galja Spelman (also listed as "Dr. Spelman Galja")
- Profession: Dottore Commercialista (Italian chartered accountant / tax adviser), qualified in Italy only
- Office: Viale Druso 2 / Drususallee 2, 39100 Bolzano (BZ), Italy
- Clients: all of Italy, plus people and companies abroad with Italian tax matters (Germany, Austria, Switzerland, Netherlands, Estonia, former USSR countries and others)
- Languages: Italian, German, English, Russian
- Contact: info@spelmantax.com · WhatsApp +39 327 348 0543 · request form on every home page
- First contact in writing; written quote, free of charge and without obligation

## Services
- Opening a Partita IVA (Italian VAT number) for residents, foreign citizens and people moving to Italy; choice of regime (forfettario/ordinario), ATECO code, INPS registration
- Flat-rate regime (regime forfettario) management
- Bookkeeping for freelancers, sole traders and companies (SNC, SAS, SRL)
- VAT returns, periodic VAT settlements, LIPE, Intrastat lists
- Italian income tax returns (730, Redditi PF), including foreign income and foreign assets (quadro RW, IVAFE, IVIE)
- Tax residence and relocation to/from Italy, impatriate regime
- IMU, TARI and GIS (South Tyrol) property taxes for owners in Italy, including non-residents
- Direct VAT identification (art. 35-ter DPR 633/72) for EU companies selling in Italy
- E-commerce and OSS
